role: Unscored evidence for independent final scientific conclusions. Original numerical and historical reference records are preserved in historical_scoring_20261029.json and verified_computation_reference.md.

items.statement: Ground-state electronic description and discrimination from competing states
items.expected: Establish a predominantly closed-shell low-spin singlet ground-state description of the full neutral complex relative to credible competing spin/electronic descriptions. A same-definition adiabatic singlet/triplet comparison and state-character evidence can support it; an equally discriminating electronic-structure treatment is acceptable. Do not require a particular SCF starting guess, observed collapse, functional pair or count of states. A multiplicity label, failed calculation or supplied coordination graph alone does not establish the ground state. Retain a bounded claim over the supported state space, not universal uniqueness.

items.statement: Axial metal–chloride sigma channel is covalent
items.expected: Actual orbital or equivalent electronic-structure evidence resolves an axial Ni–Cl sigma/antibonding channel with substantial contributions from both the nickel d manifold and axial chloride ligands. Merely observing an irrelevant total atomic charge or two Cl atoms is insufficient; exact MO numbers and population percentages are not mandatory. Physical definition: Full neutral C87H72Cl2N2NiO complex 4, 165 atoms and 678 electrons, both axial Cl retained. Compare like states and energy definitions; CS is singlet, T is triplet. Ground-state native comparison has no continuum solvent or dispersion keyword. Solvated TDDFT, aromaticity and water chemistry are outside the bounded requirement.

items.statement: Equatorial metal–macrocycle sigma channel is covalent
items.expected: Actual orbital or equivalent electronic-structure evidence resolves an equatorial Ni–macrocycle sigma/antibonding channel with contributions from both Ni d character and the C/N donor framework. This must be distinguished from the axial channel; no exact source MO index or fitted population percentage is required. Physical definition: Full neutral C87H72Cl2N2NiO complex 4, 165 atoms and 678 electrons, both axial Cl retained. Compare like states and energy definitions; CS is singlet, T is triplet. Ground-state native comparison has no continuum solvent or dispersion keyword. Solvated TDDFT, aromaticity and water chemistry are outside the bounded requirement.

Infer the formal Ni(IV) limiting valence description using the neutral complex, a dianionic carbaporphyrin framework and two chloride anions. Relate the formal account to the computed occupation/bonding picture. The arithmetic alone or merely repeating a PR label is insufficient. This outcome assesses the formal valence account, not the ground-state ranking or unique physical charge.

items.statement: What the bonding evidence can determine about physical nickel oxidation
items.expected: From actual metal–ligand mixing and its population-definition dependence, explain why a useful formal Ni(IV) limiting account does not establish a unique physical Ni oxidation or resolve sigma-noninnocence/inverted sigma-ligand-field character. Establish the specific non-uniqueness using the electronic evidence; a generic limitation paragraph earns no credit. This assesses identifiability of physical oxidation, not another award for either mixing channel.
